structured_summary: The robot announces the delivery via speech. The user must acknowledge the delivery (by speech or head nod) within 8 seconds of the announcement. After receiving the acknowledgment, the robot must give a final confirmation via speech within 1 second.

obligations.source_sentence: The robot should announce the delivery via speech.
The user is expected to acknowledge the delivery (e.g., via speech or a head nod) within 8 seconds of the announcement.
Once the acknowledgment is received, the robot must provide a final confirmation of delivery via speech within 1 second.

missing_details: failure handling if user does not acknowledge within 8 seconds
failure handling if robot does not provide final confirmation within 1 second
maximum retries for acknowledgment or confirmation
specific modality choice for acknowledgment (speech vs head nod) if both allowed
exact start point of timing (end of announcement vs beginning)
whether acknowledgment must be distinct from announcement
any environmental noise constraints beyond quiet office
potential_ambiguities: whether acknowledgment via speech or head nod is sufficient or both required
whether the 8-second window starts at the end of the robot's announcement or at its start
whether the 1-second window for final confirmation starts after acknowledgment detection or after acknowledgment completion
what constitutes 'receipt' of acknowledgment (detecting speech vs head nod)
